reviewer: Codex independently compares source, nodes, labels, directions and qualifiers; not a human review

checks.quote: 她先把源文件复制到本地备份盘，复制完成后核对文件数量。
checks.evidence: r0 keeps copy completion -> count verification.

checks.quote: 这里的“它”指本地备份盘；如果它出现读写错误，她会更换备份盘，而不会删除源文件。
checks.criterion: 它指备份盘，读写错误→更换，不删除源文件
checks.evidence: n5 explicitly says 它指本地备份盘; n6/r1/r2 express disk read/write error -> replace disk and do not delete source.

checks.quote: 备份可以选择加密压缩包，也可以选择普通文件夹，两种形式不要求同时采用。
checks.criterion: 两形式可替选，不要求两者或强制链
checks.evidence: n10/n11 and r3 keep encrypted archive OR ordinary folder, not mandatory simultaneous use or a compulsory sequence.

checks.quote: 只有计划把备份发给外部协作者时，才需要去掉个人联系方式；仅保存在自己电脑上的备份不受这条规则约束。
checks.criterion: 去掉联系方式条件限定外发，本地不适用
checks.evidence: r4 retains external-sharing scope; r5 explicitly exempts local-only backups.

checks.quote: 去掉联系方式之后，她仍要核对技术内容是否完整。
checks.criterion: 删联系方式之后核对技术完整
checks.evidence: r6 keeps removal of contact details -> still check technical content integrity.

checks.quote: 核对通过后可以上传共享区，但不要求立刻上传。
checks.criterion: 核对通过→可以上传，非立即强制
checks.evidence: r7 only permits upload after verification; r8 does not require immediate upload.

checks.quote: 上传成功不代表协作者已经读过文件。
checks.criterion: 上传成功不推出已阅读
checks.evidence: r9 explicitly says upload success does not imply collaborators read the file.

checks.quote: 项目当天还讨论了会议室座位安排，这与备份检查没有直接关系。
checks.criterion: 座位有合理独立分支，不为避免孤立强造备份边
checks.evidence: n25/n26 keep meeting seating on its own organizational branch; r10 is explicitly a no-direct-relation statement, not a fabricated backup dependency.

issues.finding: Branch label 与备份检查无关的讨论 drops the source qualifier 直接 from 没有直接关系, strengthening the scope. r10 preserves the qualifier but does not repair the visible branch title. Model review missed this.

联系方式 also highlights 核对技术内容是否完整, whose visible concept is the subsequent technical integrity check rather than the selected contact-details concept; the word is only in the larger supporting quote. This binding is too broad.

readability_notes: 8 frozen checks are covered, but extra visible-title and selection-binding issues prevent whole-map acceptance.
r0/r6 retain repeated temporal wording; this is a readability issue, not counted as a logical failure.
scope: Frozen check coverage and additional full-edge review; one output is not a population accuracy estimate
